title: TEST CHAMBER 09
pa: Long-distance handling is now part of your assessment.
Please refrain from using the unmarked inspection ledges.

addedBoxes.note: Central 1.50 m divider prevents a simple ground-level crate crossing; carry around it.
East guard makes placement on the floor plate precise.
South guard leaves the plate approachable from the west.
Concealed first inspection ledge; top at 0.65 m.
Second inspection ledge; top at 1.38 m.
Third inspection ledge; top at 2.11 m.
Fourth inspection ledge; top at 2.84 m.
Fifth inspection ledge; top at 3.57 m.
Upper walkway behind the plate area leading to the high east hatch.
Fix: staff bridge from the high walkway north to the shell catwalk at the real staff hatch (z -4.5); the walkway alone dead-ends at the wall above the door.

solution: Use the arm to press the button at (5.4, 1.8, -3.2), opening the shutter and staff hatch.
Fly the drone to the high north-west panel and zap it to set override.
Carry the heavy crate from (-5.3, 0.55, -2.8) around the central divider, then lower it carefully onto the guarded plate at (4.9, 1.45).
Use the base to leave through the unobstructed low east door.
Hidden: after the button, override and plate, find the alternating south-wall inspection ledges, climb in rises of 0.73 m or less, and cross the high walkway to exit above y = 3.
